sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Stirrup is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Ah, it's you again. Decided to stick around and do more business with me, eh? Fair enough, mate. I've got a bit of a situation I need sorted out around the region. There's always some random lot getting in the way, firing shots, taking valuable gear off my lads, and putting them down without a second thought. Doesn't exactly fit with my, let's say, business model. So I need them to understand they've stepped into something serious. Thin their numbers out with pistols and let them know there's professionals working around here. I'll pay you for every head you bring down."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate any 10 target with pistols on Factory

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Skier Rep +0.25
- 450 Euros
  - 472 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 518 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Ah-hah, now that was a stirrup if I ever seen one! I got word from all channels that some devil is at large and grounded quite a bunch of people. You rock, get your reward."
